### Diff-aware (automatic when on a feature branch with no URL)

Run `git diff <base>...HEAD --name-only` and `git log <base>..HEAD --oneline`. Map changed routes, views, components and styles to pages and test them in the browser.

**When nothing maps to a page:** browser testing is generally preferred, and a Quick pass of the homepage is usually still worthwhile for backend changes. Use your judgment about whether it adds value for this particular diff; for some backend-only branches the unit tests or evals already give better signal.
